Dear [Recipient],

We're looking for a skilled videographer to capture the excitement of Media Makers Night on March 28. The event is a unique opportunity to showcase the creativity and innovation of the media-making community, and we need someone to bring it to life on camera.

Responsibilities will include:

- Capturing B-roll footage of the event atmosphere
- Conducting short on-the-floor interviews with attendees and speakers
- Handing off organized footage for editing

While basic editing and export knowledge is a bonus, it's not required for this role. We're more interested in your ability to capture high-quality footage and work efficiently under tight deadlines.

If you're interested in this opportunity, please reply to this email with the following information:

- A list of the gear you would bring to the event
- A link to your past work (we'd love to see your style and experience)

Alternatively, you can sign up to volunteer via our registration link: https://bit.ly/MediaVolunteers

As a token of appreciation, we're offering a small fee and credit on the finished reel.

We're looking forward to hearing from you and capturing the magic of Media Makers Night together.

Best regards,
Aisha

Dear [Supervisor's Name],

I am writing to request approval to launch our monthly giving program. This initiative aims to convert 200 existing donors into recurring givers, thereby stabilizing our cash flow and increasing donor lifetime value.

Our current year-to-date revenue stands at $515,000. The proposed launch investment of $7,500 will cover the necessary creative assets, CRM setup, and a targeted conversion campaign. We anticipate modest acquisition costs, which will be recouped within the first year through recurring gifts.

Thank you

Best regards,
Aisha
